profile_text.body:
DeepMind is a research lab founded in 2010 and headquartered in London, England. According to its website, the company describes itself as focused on understanding AI systems, including exploring "the inner thoughts of AI" by examining the vast arrays of numbers that constitute AI processing. The site highlights work on autonomous agents that can execute multi-step plans and perform complex tasks, and contemplates scenarios where millions of such agents work together, transacting and negotiating with one another.

The company references its work on AlphaGo, marking a decade since what it describes as "the match that sparked the modern AI revolution." DeepMind is a for-profit organization and operates as part of the Google ecosystem.
